missing.t: Funding is the payment between longs and shorts that keeps the perp price near spot. It goes to other traders, not to the venue. That is useful to know for two reasons. Your cashback applies to the fee line, so your rebate stays simple to calculate and nothing muddies it. And if you are choosing a venue for a multi hour hold, funding will matter more than the fee, so compare it first. Intervals differ and both have an upside. Hourly funding charges more often but gives you more chances to exit before the next payment. On a four hourly schedule a quick trade may pay nothing at all. Most venues also cap how much a single interval can charge, which protects you during a squeeze.

The headline fee is one of four costs. Add fees, slippage at your size, funding, and the cost of moving money in and out. The best venue is often not the cheapest on paper. Your cashback applies to the fee line. Funding goes to other traders rather than the venue, which keeps your rebate simple to work out and makes funding the first thing to compare on a longer hold. Prefer venues that publish. A visible liquidation pool, clear auto deleveraging rules and a public incident history tell you how a venue behaves under pressure.
